description:
Implement pull-to-refresh gesture for all list and feed views. Add customizable refresh indicator, success/failure animations, and opt-out toggle for specific data views.

**Rationale:** Pull-to-refresh is an expected mobile pattern that gives users control over data freshness without navigating away from their current context.
title: Pull-to-Refresh Implementation
